OpenIDConnect.description: OpenID Connect 1.0 is a simple identity layer on top of the OAuth 2.0 protocol. It allows Clients to verify the identity of the End-User based on the authentication performed by an Authorization Server, as well as to obtain basic profile information about the End-User in an interoperable and REST-like manner.

get.description: This action fetches a list of all contacts

parameters.name: order_by
parameters.description: Defines the order of the results. Multiple sort parameters can be combined by using a comma separator. `_asc` and `_desc` can be appended to any parameter to either sort ascending (default) or descending.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Limit the number of results (max is 2000)

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: Skip over a number of elements by specifying an offset value for the query

nr.description: If set to null, the number will be assigned automatically. Must be a number, can also be used as integer

contact_type_id.description: Please use the value `1` for companies or `2` for persons

name_1.description: This field is used as the company name if the field `contact_type_id` is set to `1`. Otherwise, the field is used as the last name of the person

name_2.description: This field is used as the company addition if the field `contact_type_id` is set to `1`. Otherwise, the field is used as the first name of the person

contact_group_ids.description: References one ore multiple [contact group objects](#operation/v2ListContactGroups)

contact_branch_ids.description: References one ore multiple [contact sector objects](#operation/v2ListContactSectors)

post.description:
Search contacts via query. Please refer to the [Search](#section/API-basics/Search) section for detailed instructions.
The following search fields are supported: * `id` * `name_1` * `name_2` * `nr` * `address` * `mail` * `mail_second` * `postcode` * `city` * `country_id` * `contact_group_ids` * `contact_type_id` * `updated_at` * `user_id` * `phone_fixed` * `phone_mobile` * `fax`
